lastCommit.message:
Add LinkedIn MDX publisher

Adds a local Markdown/MDX converter for LinkedIn articles with a browser UI, CLI export flow, metadata support, diagnostics, and HTML/TXT/JSON exports. It sanitizes unsafe MDX content, warns on compatibility issues, and includes a Windows launcher, build/server scripts, documentation, and test coverage for conversion and safety behavior.
